subject: Life Skills
title: Vinegar vs Bleach
description: Learn Vinegar vs Bleach in one minute.

hook.text: Mixing vinegar and bleach creates toxic chlorine gas. People do it thinking more cleaners means cleaner.

buildup.text: Bleach is a disinfectant that kills bacteria. Vinegar is an acid that dissolves mineral deposits.

discovery.text: They solve different problems. Bleach for germs on bathroom surfaces. Vinegar for hard water stains.

twist.text: Vinegar damages marble and granite. The acid eats through stone surfaces over time.

climax.text: Never mix cleaning products. Use one, rinse completely, then switch if needed.

punchline.text: Right cleaner, right job, never together.

quiz.question: Why should you never mix vinegar and bleach?
